map.基于国际白塞病诊断标准(ICBD 2014)评估临床表现及HLA-B51关联: Assesses clinical manifestations and HLA-B51 association by the international Behcet's criteria (ICBD 2014)
map.总分≥4分可诊断白塞病。HLA-B51不直接计入评分，但作为支持证据。: Total >=4 points diagnoses Behcet's. HLA-B51 is not directly scored but serves as supporting evidence.
map.HLA-B51阳性率：白塞病患者50-80%（正常人群10-20%），尤其在地中: HLA-B51 positivity: 50-80% in Behcet's (10-20% in general population), especially Mediterranean/East Asian
map.HLA-B51阳性者：发病风险增加5-10倍: HLA-B51 positive: onset risk increased 5-10 fold
map.HLA-B51与眼部受累、病情严重程度正相关: HLA-B51 correlates positively with ocular involvement and severity
map.男性、早发(＜40岁)、HLA-B51阳性 = 预后不良三联征: Male, early onset (<40), HLA-B51 positive = poor-prognosis triad
map.HLA-B51阴性不能排除白塞病诊断: HLA-B51 negative does not exclude Behcet's diagnosis
map.提示：白塞病诊断基于临床表现综合判断，无特异性实验室指标。HLA-B51是遗传易: Note: Behcet's diagnosis is by comprehensive clinical judgment, no specific lab marker. HLA-B51 is a genetic susceptibility marker, not a diagnostic one. Ocular involvement (posterior uveitis) is the main cause of blindness, needs early ophthalmology. Vascular (venous thrombosis/aneurysm) and neuro-Behcet have poor prognosis, need aggressive immunosuppression. Treatment: colchicine for skin-mucosa, corticosteroids + immunosuppressants/biologics (anti-TNF) for visceral. For clinical reference only.
map.反复口腔溃疡+生殖器溃疡+眼葡萄膜炎+皮肤结节红斑+针刺反应+ HLA-B51: Recurrent oral ulcers + genital ulcers + ocular uveitis + skin erythema nodosum + pathergy + HLA-B51 positive + male -> meets international criteria with many prognostic factors, clear Behcet's, prone to visceral involvement.
map.仅口腔+皮肤表现、HLA-B51 阴性 → 不完全型，随访眼/血管并发症。: Only oral + skin manifestations, HLA-B51 negative -> incomplete type, follow eye/vascular complications.
map.反复口腔溃疡+任意 2 项（生殖器溃疡/眼炎/皮肤/针刺反应）即拟诊；HLA-B: Recurrent oral ulcers + any 2 (genital/eye/skin/pathergy) -> suspected; HLA-B51 relates to vascular/neuro types.
map.男性、早发、眼/血管/神经受累提示更重，需积极免疫抑制防失明与卒中。: Male, early onset, eye/vascular/neuro involvement suggest worse, need aggressive immunosuppression to prevent blindness and stroke.
map.关于「白塞病(HLA-B51)临床表现评估器」: About the Behcet's Disease (HLA-B51) Clinical Assessor
map.白塞病HLA-B51临床表现评估器，根据国际白塞病诊断标准(ICBD)评估白塞病: Behcet's HLA-B51 clinical assessor, assesses Behcet's clinical manifestations and HLA-B51 association by the international Behcet's criteria (ICBD). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
